Self-hosted browser dependencies. No install scripts executed.
Tesseract.js 7.0.0 and tesseract.js-core 7.0.0, npm registry, Apache-2.0.
PDF.js pdfjs-dist 6.5.438, npm registry, Apache-2.0.
Russian language @tesseract.js-data/rus 1.0.0 / 4.0.0_best_int, jsDelivr, Apache-2.0 (tesseract-ocr/tessdata).
Only distribution assets and license files copied. Source maps omitted. Engine paths pinned to same origin.
Runtime requests inspected on real private receipt: GET assets only; zero external requests, zero POST.
CSP blocks external connections; no analytics, no server upload, no receipt storage.
SHA256.json records asset hashes. Documentation: https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js/tree/master/docs and https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/
English/digit refinement: tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast eng.traineddata, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast (downloaded 2026-11-07). Loaded locally only for uncertain numeric cells.
